cards.ex: He's a talented musician, just like his father; like father, like son, I guess.
cards.exUz: U otasi kabi iste'dodli musiqachi; otasi bolasidek, deb o'ylayman.
cards.uzDef: Ota qanday bo'lsa, o'g'li ham shunday xulqli yoki qobiliyatli bo'ladi, degan ma'noda.

cards.ex: She's inherited her mother's fiery temper; the apple doesn't fall far from the tree.
cards.exUz: U onasining o'ta jahldorligini meros qilib olgan; olma daraxtdan uzoqqa tushmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Bolaning xarakteri ota-onasiga o'xshaydi, degan ma'noda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: I don't usually eat pasta, but when in Rome, do as the Romans do.
cards.exUz: Men odatda pasta yemayman, lekin Rimda rimliklar kabi ish qil.
cards.uzDef: Yangi muhitga moslashish kerakligini anglatadi.

cards.ex: Even though you lost your job, remember every cloud has a silver lining.
cards.exUz: Ishingizni yo'qotgan bo'lsangiz ham, esda tutingki, har bulutning kumush qirrasi bor.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday yomon vaziyatda ham yaxshi tomonga umid qilish kerak.

cards.ex: You have to take risks sometimes, because fortune favors the bold.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan tavakkal qilish kerak, chunki omad jasurlarga kulib boqadi.
cards.uzDef: Odatda, omad jasurlarga yoki qat'iyatlilarga kulib boqadi.

cards.ex: The market is booming, so let's make hay while the sun shines.
cards.exUz: Bozor gullab-yashnamoqda, shuning uchun quyosh charaqlab turganda imkoniyatdan foydalanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qulay fursatdan unumli foydalanish kerakligini anglatadi.

cards.ex: I haven't seen him in years; out of sight, out of mind.
cards.exUz: Men uni yillar davomida ko'rmadim; ko'zdan uzoq - dildan uzoq.
cards.uzDef: Uzoqda bo'lgan narsa yoki odam tezda unutiladi.

cards.ex: He was losing badly, so he decided to quit while he was ahead.
cards.exUz: U yomon mag'lubiyatga uchrayotgan edi, shuning uchun u oldinda bo'lganida to'xtatishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon ahvolga tushmasdan oldin to'xtash kerak.

cards.ex: Don't get discouraged; Rome wasn't built in a day.
cards.exUz: Umidsizlikka tushmang; Rim bir kunda qurilmadi.
cards.uzDef: Katta maqsadga erishish uchun vaqt kerak bo'ladi.

cards.ex: The iron is hot, so let's strike while we can.
cards.exUz: Temir issiq, shuning uchun qulay fursatdan foydalanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qulay fursatdan foydalanish kerak.

cards.ex: I got all the best deals; the early bird catches the worm.
cards.exUz: Men eng yaxshi narxlarni oldim; ertagi qush o'ljani qo'lga kiritadi.
cards.uzDef: Ertaroq harakat qilgan odam muvaffaqiyatga erishadi.

cards.ex: Don't retaliate; two wrongs don't make a right.
cards.exUz: Qasos olmang; ikki xato to'g'ri ish bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Xato bilan xatoni tuzatib bo'lmaydi.

cards.ex: We travel to experience new cultures; variety is the spice of life.
cards.exUz: Biz yangi madaniyatlarni kashf qilish uchun sayohat qilamiz; rang-baranglik hayotga mazmun beradi.
cards.uzDef: Har xillik hayotni qiziqarli qiladi.

cards.ex: He looks intimidating, but you can't judge a book by its cover.
cards.exUz: U qo'rqinchli ko'rinadi, lekin kitobni muqovasiga qarab baholab bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Odamni tashqi ko'rinishiga qarab baholash noto'g'ri.

cards.ex: If you work hard, you'll succeed; you reap what you sow.
cards.exUz: Agar qattiq mehnat qilsangiz, muvaffaqiyatga erishasiz; nima eksang shuni o'rasan.
cards.uzDef: O'zing qilgan ishing natijasini ko'rasan.

cards.ex: I finally finished the project, better late than never.
cards.exUz: Men nihoyat loyihani tugatdim, kech bo'lsa ham yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qilmaslikdan ko'ra kech qilib bo'lsa ham qilish yaxshiroq.

cards.ex: We haven't won the game yet, so don't count your chickens before they hatch.
cards.exUz: Biz hali o'yinda g'alaba qozonmadik, shuning uchun jo'jalar tuxumdan chiqmasdan oldin sanamang.
cards.uzDef: Ertaroq xursand bo'lish kerak emas, natija aniq bo'lguncha.

cards.ex: I put a little money aside each week; a penny saved is a penny earned.
cards.exUz: Men har hafta ozgina pul ajrataman; saqlangan tanga - topilgan tanga.
cards.uzDef: Pulni tejash kelajak uchun foydali.

cards.ex: Diversify your investments; don't put all your eggs in one basket.
cards.exUz: Investitsiyalaringizni diversifikatsiya qiling; hamma tuxumni bir savatga solmang.
cards.uzDef: Hamma resurslarni bir joyga tikmaslik kerak, chunki xavf yuqori bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Even though it's hard, honesty is the best policy in the long run.
cards.exUz: Qiyin bo'lsa ham, uzoq muddatda haqgo'ylik - eng yaxshi siyosat.
cards.uzDef: Doim to'g'ri so'zlash va halol bo'lish yaxshiroq.

cards.ex: Fix the small leak now; a stitch in time saves nine.
cards.exUz: Kichik oqishni hozir tuzating; vaqtida qilingan ish to'qqiztani saqlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtida qilingan kichik ish, katta muammoni oldini oladi.

cards.ex: She worked hard and achieved her goals; where there's a will, there's a way.
cards.exUz: U qattiq mehnat qildi va maqsadlariga erishdi; xohish bo'lsa, yo'l topiladi.
cards.uzDef: Agar xohish bo'lsa, hamma narsaga erishish mumkin.

cards.ex: They say the best things in life are free, and I'm starting to believe it.
cards.exUz: Ular aytishadi hayotdagi eng yaxshi narsalar bepul, men bunga ishonishni boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy qimmatli narsalar bepul bo'ladi yoki qiyin yo'l bilan erishiladi.

cards.ex: During the argument, I realized silence is golden and just walked away.
cards.exUz: Bahs paytida men tushundim sukut oltin ekan va shunchaki uzoqlashdim.
cards.uzDef: Ba'zida gapirmaslik gapirishdan yaxshiroqdir, ayniqsa bahslarda.

cards.ex: He doesn't say much, but still waters run deep, so don't underestimate him.
cards.exUz: U ko'p gapirmaydi, lekin tinch suvlar chuqur, shuning uchun uni past baholamang.
cards.uzDef: Tinch odamlar chuqur fikrlarga ega bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Remember to look before you leap when investing your money.
cards.exUz: Pulni investitsiya qilishda, oqibatini o'ylab qadam bosishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Biror ish qilishdan oldin, oqibatlarini o'ylab ko'ring.

cards.ex: He won the lottery, but it was easy come, easy go; he's broke again.
cards.exUz: U lotereyada yutdi, lekin oson keldi, oson ketdi; u yana pulga muhtoj.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan erishilgan narsa, osonlik bilan yo'qotiladi.

cards.ex: Remember, no pain, no gain; you have to work hard to succeed.
cards.exUz: Unutmang, azobsiz natija yo'q; muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun ko'p mehnat qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Mehnat qilmasdan natijaga erishib bo'lmaydi.

cards.ex: First the car broke down, and then I lost my job; when it rains, it pours.
cards.exUz: Avval mashina buzildi, keyin ishimni yo'qotdim; yomg'ir yog'sa, sel keladi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon narsalar bir vaqtning o'zida sodir bo'ladi.

cards.ex: I know you wanted a different room, but beggars can't be choosers.
cards.exUz: Men bilaman, siz boshqa xonani xohladingiz, lekin tilanuvchi tanlamaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yordam so'ragan odam, sharoitlarni talab qilmasligi kerak.
